newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian pilot refuses to eject, saves plane.
newsitem.headline: Russian pilot refuses to eject, saves plane.

text.p: A Russian Air Force pilot shunned the eject button when his engine failed but managed to land safely, earning the praise of the cash-strapped Russian military, officials said on Monday.
Air Force spokesman Alexander Drobishevsky said an engine on the Su-25 assault plane failed last Friday during a training flight east of Lake Baikal in Siberia.
By refusing to eject and navigating his way back on the crippled plane, the pilot, an eight-year veteran, saved the Air Force $20 to $30 million, Drobishevsky said.
He said it was up to the pilot to decide whether to use an ejector seat. "This pilot was especially courageous," the spokesman said. "He was a master of his profession."
